quotes.quote: For rank inputs one and two, and ten and twenty, sum all-reduce gives eleven and twenty-two to both ranks.

quotes.quote: Ranks must agree on operation, count, dtype and collective sequence. Swap two same-shaped layer reductions and matching shapes can still combine the wrong layer values.

quotes.quote: A compact estimate multiplies two tensors, layer count, cached tokens, KV heads, head width, and bytes per element.

Two times eighty times eight times one hundred twenty-eight times two gives three hundred twenty kibibytes per token. Eight thousand one hundred ninety-two prompt tokens hold two point five gibibytes.
Ideal two-rank KV-head sharding gives one point two five gibibytes per rank. The two shards together still contain two point five gibibytes.

answers.reason: 4096 × 256 KiB = 1 GiB total. Ideal four-rank sharding divides that total into 256 MiB per rank.

quotes.quote: At an assumed aggregate twenty-five decimal gigabytes per second, two point five gibibytes takes about one hundred seven point four milliseconds before overhead. Two independent links each at that rate can finish the two shards in fifty-three point seven milliseconds. Two streams sharing one bottleneck cannot each claim its full capacity.

answers.reason: The shared bottleneck carries 1000 MiB total. Scaling the narrated example gives 107.4 ms × (1000/2560) × (25/10) ≈ 105 ms.

quotes.quote: Reserving one hundred twenty-eight future output positions adds eight blocks, or forty mebibytes, for two thousand six hundred mebibytes. Future reserved positions are not already transferred KV.

The destination reserves enough blocks for the incoming state before transfer begins. The first request fits. A second reservation would exceed available memory, so that request waits for capacity or another compatible worker.

answers.reason: The full reservation requires 90 + 16 = 106 blocks, exceeding the 100 free blocks. The request cannot be admitted there.

quotes.quote: Keep old blocks charged until transport cancellation or completion and GPU readers confirm quiescence; then release the reservation.
Expiry immediately blocks commit, while late writes can still land in the old charged reservation. A fresh retry uses disjoint capacity until old transport and GPU readers are quiescent.

answers.reason: Lease expiry does not stop physical accesses. Reuse requires confirmation that transport writes and GPU readers have stopped.

quotes.quote: Complete unique rank-and-block coverage, compatible interpretation, integrity and connector-required visibility all precede commit. Repeated notifications do not fill missing regions.

answers.reason: 384 notifications do not establish 384 unique rank-block pairs. A repeated pair leaves required coverage unestablished.

quotes.quote: A lost commit acknowledgement means unknown outcome, not failed commit. Query the authoritative owner before starting elsewhere.

answers.reason: The missing acknowledgement leaves commit status uncertain. The router must resolve it through the authoritative owner.

A preceding twenty-five-millisecond queue makes end-to-end time four hundred point four, while the active-span union remains three hundred seventy-five point four. Measure request endpoints and explain their dependencies.
